Durable memory across sessions — a model of who the user is, not a log of what was done. Markdown core plus a RAG store via the `ling-mem` daemon. Same seman...

latestVersion.changelog: install.sh now wires the OpenClaw integration: detects ~/.openclaw/workspace/USER.md and appends a marker-bracketed 'use ling-mem as your second memory system' directive so the OpenClaw agent proactively reaches for ling-mem alongside its native MEMORY.md. Marker-bracketed and idempotent (LING_MEM_SKIP_OPENCLAW=1 to disable). Pins binary to v0.4.4 (dashboard add-fact UI sync fix).
